description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for two metrics, MMAU and MMAR, across two models: Audio-Reasoner and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The horizontal axis displays the model names as categorical labels, ordered from left to right as "Audio-Reasoner" and "Qwen-2.5-Omni". The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The chart contains two sets of bars for each model: blue bars represent MMAU, and purple bars represent MMAR. For the Audio-Reasoner model, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 61% and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 35%. For the Qwen-2.5-Omni model, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 64% and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 57%. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model, with the MMAU bar consistently taller than the corresponding MMAR bar. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model names on the horizontal axis.
